rules.rule: Base, chargeability and deduction periods are separate; input base is in registration period. Deductibility is explicitly reviewed, including reverse charge.
Exact signed formula, 1% only quarterly by option Q1-3. Q4 by option uses code 5 and omits VP11, VP12, VP14.
VP7 absent in Jan/Dec/Q1/Q4/Q5. VP8 absent in Jan/Q1 for supported single-periodicity cases. Threshold and acconto checks. No automatic small-debit carry when paid or at year end.
